boilerplate_excluded.text: Case Prompt: GreenCart Quick Commerce Expansion.
GreenCart is a mid-sized grocery delivery company operating in three Indian metro cities.
The founders are considering an expansion into ten tier-two cities over the next eighteen months.
Participants must analyse the market opportunity, evaluate the unit economics of dark stores, identify the main operational risks, and recommend a go-to-market strategy.
Answers should address customer acquisition cost, average order value, delivery time commitments, and supplier relationships.
Teams must state all assumptions clearly and support every recommendation with quantitative reasoning.
The submission should not exceed five pages and must include an executive summary, a market analysis, a financial assessment, and a risk mitigation plan.
Cite all external sources using a consistent referencing style.
Submissions will be judged on analytical depth, feasibility, clarity of communication, and originality of insight.
Late submissions will not be evaluated by the panel.
